propositions: Empirical plan-review p50/p90/p99 wall-clock duration from end-to-end Codex session telemetry is 339.9s / 790.5s / 2524s (5.7m / 13.2m / 42.1m) for inner workflow, with total command duration p50/p90 at 6.8m / 15.8m when post-sidecar overlap work and deterministic setup are included.

Empirical completion-verifier wall-clock p50/p90/p99 is 512.9s / 2237.1s / 3607.2s (8.5m / 37.3m / 60.1m) for gated transition, dominated by pre-workflow commit reference scanning that calls referencing_commits and _scan_alias repeatedly across 2,690 commits and 5,351 ticket directories.

Current regime (2026-08-22 onward) shows nonstationary performance: plan p50/p90 15.2m / 21.2m and close p50/p90 33.9m / 68.8m, indicating measurable performance shift or increased ticket complexity relative to the full-window median.

Inner-sidecar total_ms metrics exclude setup, overlap-judge work, signing, persistence, and pre-workflow deterministic scans; therefore guidance must reflect outer command wall time, not the shorter inner-workflow latency.

Provider-provenance filter (ran_model beginning bedrock:) identifies actual LLM execution and excludes deterministic short circuits; all plan cohorts (n=1,514 inner; n=78 end-to-end) retain llm_calls>0 with zero rows removed by explicit call-count validation.
